lines: Austin Peay State University requires all freshman without a declared major to select
Academic Focus (Undeclared) with a meta-major pathway.
Students prepare to declare a major within three semesters. Once a student has earned
42 credit hours, they will need to declare their major to their intended bachelor's

undeclared.declare_by_text: Declare a major by 42 earned credit hours (or change to the A.S. in University Studies).
